text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I arrived with Smart Falcon for the 
Winning Live rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Strike a pose☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Smart Falcon standing on the 
stage, I felt my excitement naturally 
rising.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fufu☆ Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez~. Trainer-san, don't make a face 
like that...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We're still just rehearsing, you know? If 
you're like this now, what will you do 
later? ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can understand why you feel that 
way. After all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Standing on stage in gorgeous outfits is 
Falco's never-ending goal, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is packed with Falco's 
feelings. There's a meaning behind the 
diamond pattern, too!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you know why it's a "diamond"?
choice_data_list: So you can shine on stage?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ding-dong! Correct☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Besides, diamonds are mined from the 
earth, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rough diamonds look like ordinary stones 
at first, but once polished by a jeweler, 
they begin to shine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So Falco wants to be polished by Trainer 
and all my fans until I'm sparkling 
bright!
choice_data_list: Let's shine bright and captivate everyone!

Let's keep pushing each other to greater 
heights!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ehehe, I'm getting all tingly with 
excitement☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Since I'm already wearing my racing 
outfit, maybe I should just do a street 
live right now☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Thanks for gathering for this 
sudden concert today!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falco~, so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: The outfit looks great on you too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks☆ Everyone's support makes Falco 
shine even brighter...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And thank you to Trainer-san, too, for 
discovering me when I was just a diamond 
in the rough Umadol♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to shine even brighter, so 
please keep cheering for me, everyone☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst warm applause, Smart Falcon and I 
renewed our determination.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Talking like this kinda makes me want to 
go for a run right now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Phew... It really feels so good☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like when I was little, captivated by 
the idols I admired and the girls I saw 
racing for the first time...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to captivate everyone 
with sparkles just like that too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that even the way she ran 
earlier had thoroughly captivated me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Let's keep joining our 
forces and doing our best together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"In both races and Lives, with all my 
heart, so that I can shine as brightly as 
I can... ☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I'll become an Umadol that 
captivates everyone even more brilliantly 
than jewels! ☆
